subject: Calista's Address Unknown list and the study we did on it
body:
Calista keeps a public list of Shareholders it can't reach and publishes no count of it. We counted 127 owners of your corporation missing distribution checks and voting materials. We already did the study on closing that list and the first thing we'd build has no AI in it.

https://alaskaaihq.com/awesomeproposal/calista-corporation/

Worth a reply either way.

Talon at Alaska AI
title_note: Calista publishes no title for him. Do not give him one.
opens_on: Calista's public Shareholder Address Unknown List, updated July 1 2026, which publishes no count. We counted 127 entries in code.
house_rule: 'own' removed after the critic flagged it as the email's only intensifier
